summary.title: Waiver claim filed: Aaron Wiggins for Reed Sheppard
summary.headline: Claim filed and verified on Yahoo 07:32 ET. It processes Sun Nov 29; Sheppard is dropped only if we win it.
summary.verdict: Wiggins beats Sheppard for the rest of the season under both projection sets. Small gain, mostly in title odds.
risks: Costs waiver priority (6th now, last if the claim wins) and 1 of 6 adds; neither is in the model.
SEs are simulation error only (3 seeds x 8,000 paired sims); projection error is larger.
Wiggins's minutes may dip when McCollum returns (~Dec 19).
5 teams have higher priority; a rival claim beats ours.
rationale: - Wiggins (ATL wing): 24.8 mpg, 13.1 pts projected; Sheppard: 21.1 mpg, 10.2 pts and falling (14-19 mpg last 3).
- Sheppard is my lowest-value healthy player and the planned next drop.
- Yahoo agrees on direction: Wiggins rank 107, 33% rostered; Sheppard rank 174, 17%.
- Independent quant review: supported with caveats (not a roster-cap or data artifact).

why_now.before: Wiggins was on Waiver Warrior's roster since Oct 24, so he was never available. Sheppard was kept on Nov 3 as the best of my fringe players.

changed.text: Waiver Warrior dropped Wiggins on Nov 26 (21:54 ET) to add Kevin Porter Jr.; he is on waivers until Nov 29.
VanVleet's return on Nov 16 cut Sheppard's minutes.

params.tool: fantasy sim compare --league-file data/manual/league_rosters_2026-27.json --add aaron-wiggins --drop reed-sheppard --sims 8000 --seed {0,1,2} [--projections var/projections_alt/market.inseason.csv] --no-save --json
